_comment: RDS SQL Server source endpoint extra settings. RDS: enable CDC with msdb.dbo.rds_cdc_enable_db 'AdventureWorks2022' then sys.sp_cdc_enable_table per table (docker/before/sql/02-enable-cdc.sql logic).

_cdc_setup.enable_tables: per table: EXEC sys.sp_cdc_enable_table @source_schema, @source_name, @role_name = NULL, @supports_net_changes = 1 (same loop as docker/before/sql/02-enable-cdc.sql)
_cdc_setup.retention_7_days: EXEC sys.sp_cdc_change_job @job_type = N'cleanup', @retention = 10080;  -- minutes (7 days); then sp_cdc_stop_job/sp_cdc_start_job N'cleanup'
_cdc_setup.dms_requirement: DMS reads the CDC tables/transaction log; keep retention >= the longest expected DMS/Lambda outage. 7 days (decision P4-4).
_cdc_setup.terraform_hook_phase7: null_resource/sqlcmd (or a one-shot Lambda) after aws_db_instance creation runs enable_db, enable_tables, retention_7_days; DMS task depends_on it.
